::: {.function-badge}
[Legitimation](../function/legitimation.qmd)
:::

Public petitions are organized campaigns, often orchestrated or amplified by Kremlin-affiliated entities, designed to simulate widespread public support for controversial policies or actions, such as territorial annexations or restrictive legislation targeting foreign influence.
